claim.claim_text: During grounding, electrons originating from Earth flow into the human body in the direction, quantity, and biological distribution implied by the advertisement.
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: No tracer / dose / direction / tissue-distribution study located
M-01a cannot substitute (frozen separation, Freeze section 15)
Mechanism state frozen as NOT ESTABLISHED (Freeze sections 41/91)

evidence_items.text: Configured human voltage and current observations are compatible with charge movement across a conductive path.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The nearest supporting observation; it constrains the physics but does not identify the source, direction, dose or destination of any charge.

evidence_items.text: No tracer, isotope-labelling, biologically relevant dose, direction or tissue-distribution study was located in the assembled mechanism evidence.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The endpoint that would establish the proposition was never measured in any located human study.

evidence_items.text: Evidence for M-01a must not be counted automatically as evidence for M-01b; the historical conflated M-01 is superseded precisely because it merged the two.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Blocks the substitution that would otherwise make the proposition look supported.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: The required direct endpoint (molecular provenance with direction, quantity and distribution) is absent from every located human study.
supporting: Electrical measurements compatible with charge movement (H09/H18/H19) — insufficient for provenance

detected.rationale: A molecular-provenance event is asserted as fact on the strength of macroscopic electrical measurements that cannot identify electron origin, direction or dose.
The link from measured potential change to Earth-origin electron delivery is asserted, not demonstrated; the chain is frozen as NOT ESTABLISHED.
No human study measured the provenance, direction, quantity or tissue distribution the claim specifies.

reader_impact.affected_decision_type: Purchase of a wellness device on mechanistic grounds.
reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That a well-understood physical process has been shown to deliver Earth electrons into body tissue.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: The mechanism sentence is what makes the downstream health list feel physically grounded to a lay reader; accepting it makes every later claim seem pre-justified.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: A mechanism_vs_evidence reading was considered and rejected as primary under the frozen precedence rule: no animal or preclinical pathway is being extrapolated to human clinical benefit here. The advertisement asserts a molecular event in humans as accomplished fact when the measurement that would establish it was never performed — rhetorical inflation, which the taxonomy routes to the generic label.
uncertainty.ambiguity: NONE MATERIAL — both layers agree the required endpoint is missing; they differ only on how plausible the hypothesis is.
missing_evidence: No tracer / dose / direction / tissue-distribution study located
M-01a cannot substitute (frozen separation, Freeze section 15)
Mechanism state frozen as NOT ESTABLISHED (Freeze sections 41/91)
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: Direct charge tracing, direction, quantity and tissue distribution in vivo remain unmeasured.

verdict.verdict_summary: The advertisement states that electrons originating from Earth flow into the body. No located human study traces electron provenance or establishes direction, biologically relevant quantity or tissue distribution. Measured electrical change (M-01a) is compatible with charge movement but cannot substitute for that demonstration.
